purpose: Reproducible platform-specific scanner-POC distribution layout for the manifest-validated local CNN observation runtime.
required_contents: runtime support files required by the platform build when the ONNX Runtime static library does not embed them
runtime_behavior: no runtime network access, telemetry, persistence, or model download
full canonical matching paths only with --show-paths
non_claims: This is a scanner observation POC, not a calibrated hybrid classification or policy release.
A successful cross-build alone is not native platform qualification.

platform_prerequisites.windows-x86_64: Windows 10 or later with DirectX 12 support and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable installed; DirectML.dll is bundled, while system Windows and Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not.
platform_prerequisites.linux-x86_64: x86_64 Linux with glibc 2.38 or newer and libstdc++.so.6 providing GLIBCXX_3.4.31 or newer. The current ONNX Runtime library is statically linked.

integrity: SHA-256 checksums cover every regular file in the unpacked bundle except CHECKSUMS.sha256 itself.
